label: Wounded
description: -1 to physical rolls until the harm falls below 4 or the wound is treated.

label: Dying
description: At 6 harm the character is dying. They can crawl, speak, or take one last action the GM allows.

label: Bleeding
description: The wound will not close. Treated, it stops; untreated, it costs harm and time.

label: Broken
description: A limb or a bone is useless. -2 to actions that use it.

label: Stunned
description: -1 to all rolls, and you cannot defend.

label: Pinned
description: You cannot move, and you are -1 to all rolls.

label: Panicked
description: -1 Presence and Wits while the panic holds.

label: Exhausted
description: -1 to all rolls until you rest.

label: Dehydrated
description: -1 Reflexes until you drink.

label: Starving
description: -1 Grit until you eat.

label: Fever
description: -1 to all rolls. Infection or sickness has its teeth in you.

label: Infected
description: The infection clock is at its worst. Without treatment, the body turns.

label: Reeling
description: -1 Wits while the mind will not settle.

label: Shaken
description: -1 Presence until you feel safe again.

label: Blinded
description: -2 to sight-based rolls until the scene ends or someone helps.

label: Deafened
description: You cannot hear, and you are -1 to awareness.

label: Prone
description: -1 to melee, and getting up costs a moment.

label: Hidden
description: +1 to Stealth, and an attack from hiding adds +1 harm.

label: Aiming
description: +1 to the next shot.

label: Inspired
description: +1 to one roll, then the feeling passes.

label: Marked
description: A horror knows where you are.

label: Rejected
description: -1 Know-how while the implant fights the body. At 6 Rejection the character is dying.

label: Addicted
description: Without the substance, -1 to all rolls.
